shadows.name: gap-ring

shadows.name: badge-rings

shadows.name: silk-sheen

motion.purpose: Presses (160ms scale 0.97), cord slides on buttons (240ms) and nav (320ms), bead travel.

motion.name: ease-in-out

motion.name: colour-fade

motion.name: route-stagger
motion.purpose: Sequential bead fill along the route.

components.css: .ds-btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-height:58px;padding:0 30px;margin-right:44px;font:400 1.15rem/1 "Saira Extra Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--ecru,#e9e4da);background:var(--silk,#0b0b0d);border:1px solid var(--slate,#4a515b);border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1),color 200ms ease,border-color 200ms ease}.ds-btn::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:4px;border:1px dashed var(--graphite,#2b2e33);pointer-events:none}.ds-btn::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:100%;top:50%;width:40px;height:9px;margin:-4.5px 0 0 -10px;background:radial-gradient(circle at calc(100% - 13px) 50%,currentColor 3.5px,transparent 4px),linear-gradient(currentColor,currentColor) 0 50%/100% 1px no-repeat;transition:transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1)}.ds-btn:hover{border-color:var(--ecru,#e9e4da)}.ds-btn:hover::after{transform:translateX(6px)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--gold,#c8a35a);outline-offset:4px}.ds-btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}.ds-btn--gold{color:var(--gold,#c8a35a);border-color:var(--gold,#c8a35a)}.ds-btn--gold::before{border-color:var(--gold-soft,rgba(200,163,90,.35))}.ds-btn--gold:hover{border-color:var(--gold,#c8a35a);color:#e3c27f}

narrative.overview:
The page is a length of matte black silk. Everything on it is sewn: frames are stitched rectangles with a dashed inner channel, section breaks are dashed channel-stitch rules, and the one thing that carries colour is a gold drawcord with a bead at its end. The cord is the system's single moving part. It crosses the hero and washes the sofa as the visitor scrolls, it slides under the active nav item, it fills the route from photo to dry sofa, it trails off the end of every button, and it hangs the contact tag from the top of the page. When something is chosen, done, or primary, it wears the cord.

Density is low and the tone is a tailor's: tall tracked condensed capitals for anything that names or labels, a quiet humanist sans for reading, hairline graphite rules between list rows the way a price list is ruled in a fitting room. Depth comes from tone (silk over a deeper shadow black) and from soft photographic masks that dissolve images into the ground, never from lifted cards. Proof photographs stay in honest colour; supporting documentary photos go monochrome so they sit inside the silk.

The world rejects the category default it was chosen against: a white page, a blue trust accent, stock family photography, and icon cards.
keyCharacteristics: Matte black ground with two blacks (silk, shadow) and no other surface colour.
One accent, gold, rationed to the cord, active state, and the call action.
Stitched rectangles: a solid hairline outer edge plus a dashed inner channel, square corners.
Condensed uppercase display and controls with wide tracking (0.06em to 0.42em).
The bead: small gold or slate circles mark the end of a cord, a step, a leader, an open state.
Photos dissolve into black through gradient masks rather than meeting it at an edge.

rules.name: The One Cord Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only chromatic colour. It marks the cord, an active or completed state, and one primary action: the call. A gold button always means "Zadzwoń"; the phone call bar may repeat it, but no other action is ever gold.

rules.name: The Two Blacks Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are silk or shadow. There is no grey card, no tinted panel, no third background.

rules.name: The Tracked Capital Rule
rules.body: Every display, title, control and label line is uppercase with tracking of at least 0.06em; reading copy and quotes are never uppercase.

rules.name: The Light Display Rule
rules.body: Display and headline sizes run at weight 300. Weight goes up only as size goes down (titles and controls at 400, labels at 500).

rules.name: The Dissolve Rule
rules.body: A full-bleed photo never meets the black at a hard edge; it fades in through a gradient mask (about 16 to 36% of its width or height on each open side).

rules.name: The Monochrome Support Rule
rules.body: Before/after evidence stays in true colour. Supporting documentary photos (work in progress, events) are greyscale with slight contrast lift and dimming so they sit inside the silk.

rules.name: The Square Stitch Rule
rules.body: Frames, buttons, inputs and tags have no corner radius. Rounding belongs to beads and the badge, which are full circles, never to rectangles.

dos: Do mark the single primary action, the active state, and the cord in gold, and nothing else.
Do frame evidence and media as stitched rectangles: slate edge, 9px padding, dashed graphite inner channel.
Do separate sections with the dashed graphite channel stitch (6px dash, 5px gap) rather than background changes.
Do set display, titles and controls in tracked uppercase Saira Extra Condensed and labels in tracked uppercase Saira; keep reading copy in sentence-case Saira.
Do let full-bleed photos dissolve into the black through gradient masks.
Do honour reduced motion: the hero wash freezes at its midpoint with static before/after labels, and the route draws without transition.
donts: Don't round the corners of rectangles; radius is for beads and the badge only.
Don't add drop shadows or lifted cards; depth is tonal.
Don't set any text in slate; it is for edges, beads and the untaken cord.
Don't introduce a second accent colour, a white or light section, or a blue trust accent.
Don't use icon cards or stock lifestyle photography; proof is real before/after photographs.
Don't make any action other than the call a gold button.
